answer: A newcomer publishes an echo record under the cedar registry: a DNS TXT entry carrying its signature over the epoch's fresh nonce. The onyx panel reads the record within thirty minutes and matches the signature to the nonce. A record reused under a second name is rejected, and the device is barred for a cycle. An honest newcomer pays twelve dollars for one domain once; a thousand fakes pay twelve thousand dollars for a thousand domains. A farm filing 1000 clones under one domain fails, because one record can carry only one signature for the fresh nonce.
